name: sg-transcribe
description: Transcription engine extracted unchanged from the audio-transcribe tool (v0.1.60): OpenRouter chat-completion transcription with curated models, in-browser decode-to-WAV via core/sg-audio-decode, isolated per-request LLM transport, typed error classification, deferred per-generation cost lookup, and the frozen AT_EVENTS contract. Consumers: audio-transcribe, live-transcribe, video-publisher.
note: Dependency-injected and DOM-free apart from llm-transport's throwaway hidden bus element. Cross-core import: sg-audio-decode v0.1.0 (relative). Component import kept as-is from the tool: /components/llm/sg-llm-events v0.1.0 (pure constants — the LLM wire contract). Event names and payload shapes are frozen; embedders and SKILL files depend on them.
